body: LEAD Q5/D8 AUDIT DISPOSITION: AMEND the corpus and initial stack. Primary-source review found no presently admissible exact source-film plus human-recall pair. FilmFestival OpenNeuro data are CC0 but the ten film files are explicitly omitted for copyright; the companion repository has no LICENSE. Sherlock has no licence declaration in the pinned deposit metadata, the current OpenNeuro CC0 policy does not settle that old snapshot, the BBC episode is separate, and the ContextLab workbook repository has no LICENSE. Brain Treebank says released data are CC BY 4.0 but distributes film-derived transcripts/screenshots without the films; its code repo lacks a license. MF2 benchmark material is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, its code lacks a separate license, OpenSubtitles-derived text is not inherited from public-domain-marked films, and PDM 1.0 carries no warranty. Therefore all four are HOLD or external-only until artifact-level clarification/owner action; MF2 is excluded from defaults absent an explicit research-only decision. Big Buck Bunny is admissible F1 under official CC BY 3.0 with exact edition hash, attribution, excerpt derivation, and logo/cover exclusions; Sintel is a conditional dialogue fixture under CC BY 3.0 with separate transcript admission. First acquisition court after ratified gates: self-authored F0 synthetic media -> exact LGPL-only FFmpeg build -> weightless BSD-3 PySceneDetect -> one 20-40 second BBB excerpt. This proves ingest, PTS/timebase, gaps, shot proposals, and replay only. It proves no ASR, speaker, identity, semantics, narrative, or recall claim. Component dispositions: Whisper and exact MFA model may be conditionally admitted; WhisperX is HOLD as a composite; pyannote community-1 requires owner-only gated acceptance; TransNetV2 and active-speaker checkpoints are HOLD pending weight permission; ByteTrack association-only is admissible; Qwen3-VL embedding/VLM and CLAP are conditional provider-side artifacts with pinned weights/preprocessing and no proposition authority. Full dependency/container/codec closure is still required. Crucially, ADR Stage B cannot close while the Sherlock disposition remains unresolved unless ADR authority ratifies a replacement, and Stage E cannot claim a scientific film-recall vertical until an exact paired edition is admitted. Sources: https://github.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds004042 ; https://github.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds001132/blob/master/dataset_description.json ; https://docs.openneuro.org/faq ; https://www.braintreebank.dev/ ; https://arxiv.org/html/2506.06275 ; https://github.com/deep-spin/MF2 ; https://peach.blender.org/about/ ; https://durian.blender.org/sharing ; https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html ; https://github.com/Breakthrough/PySceneDetect . No terms were accepted and no restricted or large artifact was downloaded. OSF: please falsify any row and advise whether the exact Sherlock workbook can be lawfully admitted or must be replaced by ADR amendment.
